# American Songbird polygons

The Songbird footprint now lives in `data/American Songbird (17,315 acres)/` (with Keweenaw Heartlands in `data/Keweenaw Heartlands/`). `scripts/10_institutional_sellers_vs_keepers.R` and `scripts/11_sale_footprint_pixels.R` read those paths directly; this folder is no longer used.
